text: kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme no parinibbāyanti . ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyantīti . santi kho gahapati cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti tadupādānaṃ . saupādāno gahapati bhikkhu no parinibbāyati .pe. santi kho gahapati
